events.title: Kenya races to trace all contacts after first Ebola death, WHO official says
events.description: Kenya’s first Ebola death has triggered a race to trace everyone the victim came into contact with, as the United Nations and partners provide full support, the World Health Organization’s (WHO) top official in the country has told UN News in her first interview on the case.
